implement.approach: Started from BASE d8e5db3e on devin/pp/w02-01/impl-r3. Reused the sound core of the r2 suite (real node:sqlite, file-backed, one fresh connection per simulated process, committed-state reads via an independent DatabaseSync connection, crash-after-every-durable-step replay) and strengthened it: (1) machine-checked enumeration of the durable step kinds the matrix kills at — DURABLE_STEP_KINDS asserted exactly (16 kinds: BEGIN IMMEDIATE, COMMIT, the batch SELECT, the ordinal SELECT, UPDATE last_attempt_order, parent-lookup SELECT (queuedSession), conflict SELECT LIMIT 51, DELETE parent row, INSERT OR REPLACE sync_receipt, UPDATE last_error, SELECT local_session, INSERT reconstructed session.create, SELECT count(*), plus createSession / finalizeSession / syncShots round trips); (2) two extra transport fault models replayed at every round trip — lost acknowledgement (server applied, client sees ApiError 408 network.timeout, exactly what api.ts raises) and refused (nothing applied, 503) — with the invariant that no attempt budget is consumed and no receipt exists for a shot the server did not accept; (3) an orphan-dependent scenario: shot.sync queued with NO session.create row while local_session survives — the server's shot.session_not_found rejection must lead recoverSession to reconstruct the parent, and the parent must be remotely acknowledged AND durably removed before the shot is accepted (a committed reconstructed parent joins the parent set so later sends are held to the same rule); (4) a shot whose session exists nowhere locally is sent once, parked with repair_reason session.missing, no receipt, no retries, no consumed attempts; (5) seeding mirrors repository.ts saveAnalysis (local_shot + outbox in the same committed state) — without it db.ts's open-time prune of shotless sessions deletes the local_session on restart, which was a test-model gap, not a product defect. Ran the final suite on BASE_SHA in a clean worktree: 30/30 pass -> no defect reproduced, so per AC2 the candidate is an honest proof-only package: sync.ts and syncRuntime.ts are byte-identical to BASE (git diff BASE..HEAD touches only the test file). Discriminating power was established with six temporary behavioural mutations of sync.ts (parent deleted before remote ack; parent lookup restricted to the 50-row batch; dependents not held after a transient parent failure; finalize ignoring a pending parent; orphan parent not reconstructed; receipt written for a rejected shot) — every mutant fails the suite (12/15/10/4/5/6 failing tests respectively); sync.ts restored and verified identical (filecmp) before commit.

residual_risks: Proof scope is the local drain (drainOutbox) against a fake transport that models Supabase semantics (idempotent session create by client UUID, shot.session_not_found for a missing parent, 408 timeout / 503 refusal). The real Edge Function and syncRuntime.ts scheduling/backoff are not exercised (syncRuntime.ts unchanged and covered only by the existing sync*.test.ts suites).
Crash model is process death after a completed statement (PRAGMA synchronous=OFF, connection closed); power loss mid-fsync and SQLite file corruption are not modelled.
Physical device process-death acceptance remains outstanding per docs/RELEASE_READINESS_2026-09-07.md §11 (Apple plane, not this cloud package).

The suite takes ~75 s (30 tests, ~1,900 drain replays); it stays within Jest's default per-test timeout with margin (crash windows of 100 steps), but a much slower runner could approach it. No timeouts were changed.

adversary.summary:
NO CONFIRMED BREAK. Candidate 954a3778 (proof-only: sync.ts/syncRuntime.ts byte-identical to BASE d8e5db3e; only apps/mobile/__tests__/w02OutboxDependencyOrder.test.ts added) survived all 38 attacks in apps/mobile/__tests__/w02OutboxDependencyOrder.attack.test.ts (pushed on devin/pp/w02-01/attack-954a3778 @ ce5c6e31). Every attack drives the real drainOutbox against a file-backed node:sqlite DB; on EVERY dependent send (shot.sync / session.finalize) the fake transport asserts (a) the server holds the parent and (b) an INDEPENDENT node:sqlite connection sees zero committed session.create rows for that session; committed state (rows, attempts, repair_reason, sync_receipt) is snapshotted through the independent connection after each drain.

ATTACK CATEGORIES (13 groups, 38 tests) — all VERIFIED passing on candidate (cmd: `cd apps/mobile && npx jest --ci __tests__/w02OutboxDependencyOrder.attack.test.ts`, exit 0, 38 passed/0 failed/0 skipped, artifacts/w02-01-attack/attack_suite_on_candidate.log):
A1 concurrency/reentrancy: two drainOutbox() calls in flight on one queue (parent held on the wire while the second drain starts) -> no dependent ahead of parent, exactly-once final state.
A2 interleaved account switch while parent is on the wire -> drain rejects with DataOwnerChangedError under the new owner; queue untouched; nothing acknowledged/deleted cross-owner.
A3 cross-account isolation: another owner's session.create row is never sent, deleted or budgeted by the active owner's drain.
A4 network failure at the parent step x13: 400/403/404/409/422 (permanent -> dependents parked 'session.parent_rejected', never sent, sibling set drains); 401/408/429/500/502/503/302 and a non-HTTP connection reset (transient -> dependents held with attempts=0, ordered drain on retry).
A5 parked/exhausted parent BEYOND the 50-row batch (parent repair_reason set; parent attempts>=8): none of its 50 shots nor its finalizer reach the wire.
A6 local acknowledgement failure after server ack: DELETE statement fails / COMMIT of the DELETE fails -> parent stays queued with attempts=0, dependents held, next drain completes in order.
A7 shot accepted but sync_receipt INSERT fails -> no receipt without delete, no delete without receipt, budget intact, replay converges.
A8 server replica lag (parent acked this drain, shot refused shot.session_not_found) -> parent reconstructed from local_session, no fabricated receipt, no budget spent, correct order on retry.
A9 corrupt parent payload x4 (invalid JSON, JSON array, numeric id, missing id) -> never sent, parent budgeted permanently, shot never acknowledged, parent rebuilt from local session.
A10 corrupt drain schedule: last_attempt_order=Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER -> drain fails closed (rejects, nothing sent, nothing changed, on every attempt); negative last_attempt_order tolerated, ordering holds.
A11 duplicate identities: two session.create rows for one session -> both acknowledged before the shot, exactly one receipt; a parked duplicate parent beside a healthy one -> healthy parent acknowledged, shot parked (conservative, no misorder).
A12 clock boundaries in parent reconstruction x6: startedAt 1999 / 2100 / non-ISO / no-TZ / impossible date -> no parent fabricated, shot parked for repair, nothing acknowledged; last instant of 2099 reconstructed and acknowledged before the shot.
A13 explicit repair retry (repository.retryShotSync) after a permanently refused parent: with an accepting server -> create, finalize, shot exactly once; with a still-refusing server -> nothing dependent leaves, set parked again.
